name: ciphora
description: Ciphora trading simulation platform with Node API and Next.js dashboard

scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-clean.mjs && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @hype/api" "npm run dev --workspace @hype/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hype/api && npm run build --workspace @hype/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @hype/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @hype/web
